description: Find upcoming public events in Montréal, Canada. Filter by keyword, borough (arrondissement, e.g. "Ville-Marie", "Le Plateau-Mont-Royal") and date window. Returns events sorted by start date. Content is in French.

from.description: Include events ending on/after this date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

query.description: Keyword over title and description, e.g. "musique", "festival", "famille".

to.description: Include events starting on/before this date YYYY-MM-DD.

name: events
title: Events
